messages:
maya_sales: Hey team, AcroSystems POC question: they force daily egress IP rotation but their security team will only whitelist 3 IPs at any one time. No EIP purchases allowed. Any practical setup for Dedicated endpoints?

leo_neteng: Short: conflict. Rotation demands a larger pool; allowlisting only 3 IPs means either we present 3 stable IPs that rotate behind a proxy we control, or use cert-based auth so IPs matter less. Options below.

leo_neteng: Option 1: Dedicated pool with 3 static EIPs. We rotate outbound backend nodes internally, but egress seen by customer stays those 3. Rotation requirement not satisfied if they mean 'change daily'.

leo_neteng: Option 2: We run a small Redwood-managed proxy with daily rotating addresses. Customer opens 3 DNS names / proxy IPs (we can keep A records point to rotating infra) but FW would need DNS-based or short TTL support.

maya_sales: They explicitly require "IPs change every day" to satisfy audit. DNS changes won't cut it for auditor unless they accept rotation proof.

tara_secp: We can provide rotation attestations: signed rotation manifest (JSON + signature) containing old/new mapping and timestamp, plus per-day logs. Also can enable mTLS to avoid relying on IP identity. If they accept cert-based allowlist, we issue short-lived client certs rotated daily.

jordan_support: What's needed from them to enable mTLS? CA or do we issue certs? Any client work?

tara_secp: We can do either: they provide CA bundle and we mint client certs from it, or they accept Redwood-issued client certs and present those to their gateway. For POC we recommend Redwood-issued to speed things up. We will rotate certs daily and publish validity.

leo_neteng: Practical POC proposals to send to AE: (A) mTLS primary: Redwood issues daily short-lived client certs, customer whitelists our control IP (one stable) + validates client cert. Minimal FW changes. (B) IP rotation primary: customer allows a /29 (8 addresses) for POC so we can rotate among those; we publish rotation manifest daily.

maya_sales: Any pricing impact for issuing daily certs or running proxy?

jordan_support: For a limited POC we can waive infra fees; running a managed proxy at small scale has negligible incremental cost. Cert issuance automation is covered by platform. Finance approval needed for extended POCs.

opsbot: Ticket POC-ACRO-42 created and assigned to leo_neteng, tara_secp. SLA: 48h to produce proposal doc and sample rotation manifest.

maya_sales: I'll send both options to AcroSystems: lead with mTLS flow and include sample manifest + curl test. If they veto certs, propose /29 allowlist fallback. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
